contract: Compare verdict, charged capacity and remaining capacity after each storage operation and spent and remaining units after each work charge.

The storage scripts compare limits and backpressure, reservation resize and teardown, retained capacity across cloned and sliced bytes, vector replacement and freeze. The pool and shared-owner header charge are verified and the target-dependent fixed sizes are projected out of the canonical rows.
A failed charge preserves the existing accounting. Work take may charge partially while try_charge is all-or-nothing.
